```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(reshape2)
library(magick)
library(scales)

load("../V1_43/V1_43.RData")
resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed <- resultsLOOCVBA1BA2
BA1BA2_fixed <- BA1BA2

load("Dynamic_log.RData")
resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_dynamic <- resultsLOOCVBA1BA2
```

```{r Prediction Visualization BA1BA2_fixed}
dataToPlot <- data.frame(
  country = names(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed),
  actual = sapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, function(x) x$actuals[1]),  
  overallMean = sapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, function(x) x$overalMean),
  sd = sapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, function(x) sd(sapply(x$perImputation, function(p) mean(p$predictions)))))

dataToPlot$lowerCI <- dataToPlot$overallMean - dataToPlot$sd
dataToPlot$upperCI <- dataToPlot$overallMean + dataToPlot$sd

specific_countries <- c("Austria", "Denmark", "India", 
   "Malaysia", "Singapore", "South Africa", "South Korea", "Sweden", "Thailand")

dataToPlot$label <- ifelse(dataToPlot$country %in% specific_countries, dataToPlot$country, "")

p1 <- ggplot(dataToPlot, aes(x = actual, y = overallMean)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lowerCI, ymax = upperCI), width = 0.01, color = "lightgray") +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3.2,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0.1,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    seed = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits = c(0.01, 100),
    breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    labels = label_comma(drop0trailing = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(0.01, 100),
    breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    labels = label_comma(drop0trailing = TRUE)
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Observed Relative Wave Size of BA.2 to BA.1 (log scale)",
    y = "Mean Prediction (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

ggsave("BA2BA1_RF_fixed.pdf", plot = p1, width = 7, height = 7)  
```

```{r quadrant log plot BA1BA2_fixed}
# Create a new category for correct and incorrect predictions
dataToPlot$predictionCategory <- ifelse(
  (dataToPlot$actual > 1 & dataToPlot$overallMean > 1) |
  (dataToPlot$actual < 1 & dataToPlot$overallMean < 1),
  "Correct Prediction", "Incorrect Prediction")

# Create the quadrant plot
quadrant_plot <- ggplot(dataToPlot, aes(x = actual, y = overallMean, color = predictionCategory)) +
  
  # Add points, with size 3
  geom_point(size = 3, pch = 19) +
  
  # Add labels to the "Incorrect Prediction" points, ensuring they don't overlap
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(dataToPlot, predictionCategory == "Incorrect Prediction"),
                  aes(label = country),
                  box.padding = 0.5, 
                  point.padding = 0.5,
                  segment.color = 'grey50',
                  show.legend = FALSE, seed = 1) +
                  
  # Set the colors for the prediction categories
  scale_color_manual(name = "Prediction", 
                     values = c("Correct Prediction" = "steelblue", "Incorrect Prediction" = "red")) +
                     
  # Apply a log10 scale to the x and y axes with specified limits
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.01, 100), breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = scales::label_comma(drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.01, 100), breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = scales::label_comma(drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
  
  # Add the dashed reference lines at y=1 and x=1
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray") +
  
  # Set the plot labels
  labs(x = "Observed Relative Wave Size of BA.2 to BA.1 (log scale)",
       y = "Mean Prediction (log scale)") +
       
  # Apply a black and white theme and remove grid lines
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") 

ggsave("quadrant_log_plot_fixed.pdf", plot = quadrant_plot, width = 7, height = 7)
```

```{r evaluation metrics BA1BA2_fixed}
calculateMetrics <- function(actuals, predictions) {
  residuals <- mean(predictions - actuals)
  mae <- mean(abs(predictions - actuals))
  mse <- mean((predictions - actuals)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  
  return(list(Residuals = residuals, MAE = mae, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse))
}

metrics_BA1BA2_fixed <- lapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, function(countryResult) {
  calculateMetrics(countryResult$actuals, countryResult$aggregated)
})

# Initialize variables to store sums of metrics
totalMAE <- 0
totalMSE <- 0
totalRMSE <- 0

numCountries <- length(metrics_BA1BA2_fixed)

# Sum up all metrics
for (countryMetrics in metrics_BA1BA2_fixed) {
  totalMAE <- totalMAE + countryMetrics$MAE
  totalMSE <- totalMSE + countryMetrics$MSE
  totalRMSE <- totalRMSE + countryMetrics$RMSE
}

# Calculate the mean of each metric across all countries
meanMAE <- totalMAE / numCountries
meanMSE <- totalMSE / numCountries
meanRMSE <- totalRMSE / numCountries

# Calculate R^2
summary(lm(dataToPlot$overallMean ~ dataToPlot$actual))

# Create a data frame for the metrics
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MAE", "MSE", "RMSE"),
  Value = c(meanMAE, meanMSE, meanRMSE)
)

kable(metrics_df, 
      caption = "Overall Model Performance Metrics for BA1BA2_fixed",
      align = 'l')

# Calculate density and mean
relsize_density <- density(BA1BA2_fixed[[1]]$relsize)  
mean_relsize <- mean(BA1BA2_fixed[[1]]$relsize)

# Plot density
plot(relsize_density, 
     main="BA1BA2_fixed Relsize Density Plot", 
     xlab="Relsize", ylab="Density")
abline(v=mean_relsize, col="black", lwd=2, lty=2) # Add vertical line for mean
text(mean_relsize, max(relsize_density$y), labels="Mean Relsize", pos=4, col="black")  # Label for mean

hist(BA1BA2_fixed[[1]]$relsize, breaks=25)
```

```{r residual plots BA1BA2_fixed}
# Initialize vectors to store the residuals and predicted values
all_residuals <- c()
all_predicted <- c()

# Loop through each country
for(country in names(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed)) {
  # Extract the predicted value 
  predicted_value <- resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed[[country]]$overalMean
  # Extract the residual 
  residual <- metrics_BA1BA2_fixed[[country]]$Residuals
  
  # Append to the vectors
  all_residuals <- c(all_residuals, residual)
  all_predicted <- c(all_predicted, predicted_value)
}

# plot the residuals against the predicted values
plot(all_predicted, all_residuals, 
     main="Residuals vs Predicted Values for All Countries", 
     xlab="Predicted Values (overallMean)", ylab="Residuals", 
     pch=19, col='steelblue')

# Add a horizontal line at 0 to indicate no error
abline(h=0, col="red", lwd=2)

# Density Plot of Residuals
dens <- density(all_residuals)
plot(dens, main='Density Plot of Residuals', xlab='Residuals', ylab='Density')

# Create the empirical CDF
residuals_ecdf <- ecdf(all_residuals)

# Plot the CDF
plot(residuals_ecdf, main="CDF of Residuals", xlab="Residuals", ylab="Cumulative Probability", col='steelblue', lwd=2)

# QQ plot for Normal distribution
qqnorm(all_residuals, main="Q-Q Plot of Residuals", col='steelblue', pch=19)
qqline(all_residuals, col="red", lwd=2)
```

```{r feature importances BA1BA2_fixed}
# Extract and aggregate feature importance data across all countries using the "%IncMSE" column
aggregated_importance_all <- lapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, function(res) res$featureImportance)

# Aggregate the "%IncMSE" column across all results by summing and averaging
average_importance <- Reduce("+", lapply(aggregated_importance_all, function(x) x[, "%IncMSE"])) / length(aggregated_importance_all)

# Create a data frame with features and their aggregated importance values
importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(aggregated_importance_all[[1]]),
                            Importance = average_importance)

# Remove underscores from the feature names
importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Feature <- gsub("_", " ", importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Feature)

replacements <- c(
  "icu patients per million" = "ICU patients per million",
  "hosp patients per million" = "hospital patients per million",
  "gdp per capita" = "GDP per capita",
  "cardiovasc death rate" = "cardiovascular death rate",
  "Nucleocapsid..N.protein..Multiple.groups" = "Nucleocapsid N protein levels",
  "Nucleocapsid..N.protein...Spike.Multiple.groups" = "Nucleocapsid N protein and Spike protein levels",
  "Spike.Multiple.groups" = "Spike protein levels",
  "sel coeff" = "selection coefficient",
  "s gene" = "genetic distance: S gene",
  "total" = "genetic distance: all genes",
  "SeasonFall" = "Fall",
  "SeasonSpring" = "Spring",
  "SeasonSummer" = "Summer",
  "SeasonWinter" = "Winter",
  "male smokers" = "male smokers prevalence",
  "female smokers" = "female smokers prevalence",
  "number of variants" = "number of cocirculating variants"
)

# Replace the feature names based on the named vector
importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Feature <- sapply(importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Feature, function(x) {
  if (x %in% names(replacements)) {
    return(replacements[x])
  } else {
    return(x)
  }
})

# Plot the feature importance 
ggplot(importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Feature Importance", x = "Feature", y = "% Increase in MSE") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r evaluation metrics Dynamic}
# 1. Calculate metrics
calculateMetrics <- function(actuals_log, predictions_log) {
  # Exponentiate to return to original scale
  actuals <- exp(actuals_log)
  predictions <- exp(predictions_log)
  
  residuals <- mean(predictions - actuals)
  mae <- mean(abs(predictions - actuals))
  mse <- mean((predictions - actuals)^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  
  return(list(Residuals = residuals, MAE = mae, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse))
}

metrics_BA1BA2_dynamic <- lapply(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_dynamic, function(countryResult) {
  calculateMetrics(countryResult$actuals[1], countryResult$overalMean)
})

# Initialize variables to store sums of metrics
totalMAE <- 0
totalMSE <- 0
totalRMSE <- 0

numCountries <- length(metrics_BA1BA2_dynamic)

# Sum up all metrics
for (countryMetrics in metrics_BA1BA2_dynamic) {
  totalMAE <- totalMAE + countryMetrics$MAE
  totalMSE <- totalMSE + countryMetrics$MSE
  totalRMSE <- totalRMSE + countryMetrics$RMSE
}

# Calculate the mean of each metric across all countries
meanMAE <- totalMAE / numCountries
meanMSE <- totalMSE / numCountries
meanRMSE <- totalRMSE / numCountries

summary(lm(dataToPlot$overallMean_log ~ dataToPlot$actual_log))

# Create a data frame for the metrics
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("MAE", "MSE", "RMSE"),
  Value = c(meanMAE, meanMSE, meanRMSE)
)
kable(metrics_df, caption = "Overall Model Performance Metrics for Dynamic", align = 'l')

# 2. Density Plot
relsize_vals <- exp(BA1BA2[[1]]$relsize) 
relsize_density <- density(relsize_vals)  
mean_relsize <- mean(relsize_vals)

plot(relsize_density,     
     main = "Dynamic Relsize Density Plot",     
     xlab = "Relsize", ylab = "Density")
abline(v = mean_relsize, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2) # Add vertical line for mean
text(mean_relsize, max(relsize_density$y), labels = "Mean Relsize", pos = 4, col = "black")
```

```{r}
# Helper function to process importance data and rename features
extract_importance <- function(results, model_label) {
  aggregated_all <- lapply(results, function(res) res$featureImportance)
  avg_imp <- Reduce("+", lapply(aggregated_all, function(x) x[, "%IncMSE"])) / length(aggregated_all)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(aggregated_all[[1]]),
    Importance = avg_imp,
    Model = model_label
  )
  
  df$Feature <- gsub("_", " ", df$Feature)
  
  replacements <- c(
    "icu patients per million" = "ICU patients per million",
    "hosp patients per million" = "hospital patients per million",
    "gdp per capita" = "GDP per capita",
    "cardiovasc death rate" = "cardiovascular death rate",
    "Nucleocapsid..N.protein..Multiple.groups" = "Nucleocapsid N protein levels",
    "Nucleocapsid..N.protein...Spike.Multiple.groups" = "Nucleocapsid N protein and Spike protein levels",
    "Spike.Multiple.groups" = "Spike protein levels",
    "sel coeff" = "selection coefficient",
    "s gene" = "genetic distance: S gene",
    "total" = "genetic distance: all genes",
    "SeasonFall" = "Fall",
    "SeasonSpring" = "Spring",
    "SeasonSummer" = "Summer",
    "SeasonWinter" = "Winter",
    "male smokers" = "male smokers prevalence",
    "female smokers" = "female smokers prevalence",
    "number of variants" = "number of cocirculating variants"
  )
  
  df$Feature <- sapply(df$Feature, function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(replacements), replacements[x], x))
  return(df)
}

# 1. Extract data
importance_df_BA1BA2_dynamic <- extract_importance(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_dynamic, "BA2/BA1 or Delta")
importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed <- extract_importance(resultsLOOCVBA1BA2_fixed, "BA2/BA1")

# 2. Define feature order based on BA2/BA1 importance values
feature_order <- importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Feature[order(importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed$Importance)]

# 3. Combine datasets and apply the factor ordering
combined_importance <- rbind(importance_df_BA1BA2_dynamic, importance_df_BA1BA2_fixed)
combined_importance$Feature <- factor(combined_importance$Feature, levels = feature_order)

# 4. Plot side-by-side grouped bars
p <- ggplot(combined_importance, aes(x = Feature, y = Importance, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BA2/BA1" = "#4682B4", "BA2/BA1 or Delta" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Feature Importance Comparison",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "% Increase in MSE",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  filename = "feature_importance_comparison_Dynamic.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
